final_answers.reason: In the corrected May 1–3 historic cohort, North bicycle completion was 18/60 (30%) and van completion was 21/70 (30%); South bicycle completion was 20/50 (40%) and van completion was 24/60 (40%). Rates were equal at both depots. These historic results do not establish any later enrollment policy.

The owner has not authorized complete automated-catalog release. Full release requires written full-catalog permission and checking and correcting names and dates on every page; neither requirement is recorded as satisfied through May 15. Exhibition-excerpt permission is separate and does not establish transcription accuracy or full-catalog authorization.

Dawn-shift deliveries were excluded from the historic cohort, and no separate dawn-shift outcome comparison was collected. A causal improvement for this subgroup is therefore not established; the missing data do not establish zero effect.
